concepts.name: Business Startups And Innovation 156 8.1
concepts.simple_definition: Unit 8: Business startups and Innovation 156 8.1 Innovation By the end of this section, students will be able to; 6 Describe innovation 6 Mention the types of innovation Key Concepts Innovation; Product, process, market, eco-, organizational, Innovations; Creative destructions Start Up Activity What is innovation? Definition of Innovation The Oslo Manual, an international reference guide from the OECD for collecting and using data on innovation, defined the concept of innovation as: “(…) a new or improved product or process (or a combination thereof) that differs significantly from the unit’s previous products or processes and that has been made available to potential users (product) or brought into use by the unit (process).” Innovation can be defined as something new, improved or introduced that creates value
concepts.deep_explanation: It can be summarized into two key elements: creativity and implementation
concepts.real_example: Practical example of Business startups and Innovation 156 8.1 from page 164.
concepts.common_confusion: Students sometimes confuse Business startups and Innovation 156 8.1 with adjacent topics in Chapter 8.

concepts.simple_definition: Unit 8: Business startups and Innovation 157 I
